Shokin vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:33861) on 14 August,
2024
[2024:Rj-Jd:33861]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At

S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 4762/2024
Shokin S/o Rajesh Kumar, Aged About 25 Years, R/o Vasi Village
Durzanpur Tehsil And District Bhiwani Hisar Hariyana.

----Petitioner
 Versus
1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
2.
Smt Suman W/o Suresh Kumar Jat, R/o Chack Chidiya
Gandhi Bhirani Hanumangarh At Present Balsamand Hisar

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Monga
Order 14/08/2024
1. Quashing of FIR No.0209/2024 dated 19.06.2024, registered at P.S. Bhirani, Hanumangarh for the alleged offences under Sections 376(2)(n), 450, 365 & 506 IPC, is sought herein.

2. While learned counsel for the petitioner would argue that the incident complained by the complainant dates back a year ago and on that ground alone the FIR deserves to be quashed being an after thought with oblique motive to harass the petitioner.
3.

On a Court query, at the very outset, learned Public Prosecutor apprises that as per the factual report received by him, the complainant has already reported to the I.O. that she does not wish to press any charges against the petitioner.

Being so, it is expected of the Investigating Agency that as per the factual report, a copy of which has been tendered before this Court is [2024:RJ-JD:33861] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4762/2024] taken on record, they shall take appropriate steps to file a closure report before the competent court in accordance with law.
No further proceedings are warranted before this Court.

(ARUN MONGA),J 70-Rmathur/-
